A debug human Valkyrie level-teleports to level 8, which this seed makes the Oracle, maps it, teleports beside the up staircase, wishes for a trap door there, steps east and dies by a wand of death, saving bones. A second game on another seed and clock, whose Oracle is level 5, loads them on level 5, teleports to the down staircase and descends to level 6 (not 9), climbs back, teleports to the up staircase, steps onto the trap door and falls to level 6. The seeds were chosen for their Oracle depths.
